name: Barbell Landmine Lateral Raise
steps: Stand side-on to a bar secured at the far end and hold the free end in the hand farther from the anchor, across your body.
Lead with your elbow to sweep the end of the bar outward toward shoulder height.
Guide the bar down and across to the starting position.
Switch sides after finishing this side.
tips: Keep a slight bend in your working elbow throughout the raise.
Avoid leaning away or shrugging your trap to swing the bar upward.
